<!DOCTYPE html>

<html class="notranslate" lang="nl" translate="nl">
    <head>
        <meta content="notranslate" name="google" />
        <meta charset="utf-8" />
        <meta
            content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, shrink-to-fit=no"
            name="viewport"
        />
        <title>ESPN Fantasy Voetbal</title>
        <link href="https://fantasy.espngoal.nl" rel="home" />
        <meta content="ar" property="locale" />
        <!-- favicons -->
        <link
            href="/img/favicons/180x180.png"
            rel="apple-touch-icon"
            sizes="180x180"
        />
        <link
            href="/img/favicons/32x32.png"
            rel="icon"
            sizes="32x32"
            type="image/png"
        />
        <link
            href="/img/favicons/16x16.png"
            rel="icon"
            sizes="16x16"
            type="image/png"
        />
        <link
            href="/img/favicons/favicon.svg"
            rel="mask-icon"
            type="image/svg+xml"
        />
        <link href="/img/favicons/manifest.json" rel="manifest" />
        <link href="https://fantasy.espngoal.nl" rel="canonical" />
        <meta content="" name="description" />
        <meta content="ESPN Fantasy Voetbal" property="og:title" />
        <meta content="ESPN Fantasy Voetbal" property="og:description" />
        <meta content="ESPN Fantasy Voetbal" property="og:site_name" />
        <meta content="https://fantasy.espngoal.nl" property="og:url" />
